title: How should long steel pipes be supported inside and outside a 4-metre furnace chamber?
summary: Chamber depth and whole-pipe length are different dimensions. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s bogie-hearth heating proposal dated 7 September 2023 specifies a 4 m-deep chamber and 4–13 m pipes, inserted at an incline with protective grooves at the internal contact end and soft-contact support beneath the opening. First establish the length requiring heat and the loading orientation, then check internal/external supports. The 13 m range does not mean an entire pipe fits inside or heats uniformly in a 4 m chamber.
